title: The free will worth wanting survives Libet

statements.text: Reports that the urge to act follows predictive motor activity can be explained by effective connectivity with a largely unconscious inner network. Free will may be an illusion in some cases but not for the varieties worth wanting, since most actions unfold within conscious planning, and agency is like a conductor with an orchestra, neither omnipotent nor epiphenomenal.
